# launchdarkly_environment_default_release_plan (Data Source)

Provides a LaunchDarkly environment default release plan data source.

~> **Beta:** This data source wraps a beta LaunchDarkly API (the `default-release-plan` endpoint, accessed with the `LD-API-Version: beta` header). Beta resources may change or be removed in future versions.

This data source allows you to look up which release plan is the default for a LaunchDarkly environment. It returns an error when the environment has no default release plan.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "launchdarkly_environment_default_release_plan" "production" {
  project_key     = "example-project"
  environment_key = "production"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `environment_key` (String) The key of the environment.
- `project_key` (String) The project key of the environment.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID in the format `project_key/environment_key`.
- `release_plan_key` (String) The key of the environment's default release plan.
